import awkward as ak
from coffea.nanoevents import NanoEventsFactory
from pocket_coffea.lib.analysis_tools import BaseProcessor


class DimuonProcessor(BaseProcessor):
    """Minimal dimuon analysis processor."""
    
    def process_objects(self, events):
        """
        Object preselection: create MuonGood collection.
        Muons with pT > 15 GeV and |eta| < 2.4
        """
        muons = events.Muon
        
        muon_mask = (muons.pt > 15) & (ak.abs(muons.eta) < 2.4)
        events["MuonGood"] = muons[muon_mask]
        
        return events
    
    def count_objects(self, events):
        """
        Object counting: store number of selected muons per event.
        """
        events["nMuonGood"] = ak.num(events["MuonGood"])
        
        return events


if __name__ == "__main__":
    processor = DimuonProcessor()
